name: qa-ai-assisted
description: AI-assisted test generation: LLM-written tests from natural-language specs with confidence scoring, spec coverage gap mapping, and model-based testing. Builds state-machine models and turns them into test suites, and adds adversarial review agents (ai-test-curator, ai-test-shallow-coverage-critic) that catch hallucinated APIs, weak assertions, and happy-path-only coverage.
